units: <cite ref="Eruvin 42b:7">Erub. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>תקרת … חוֹבֶטֶת</he> the roofing of the house presses upon him (keeps him mindful of the Sabbath limit); v. <cite ref="H00022"><he>חָבוּט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 80b:3">B. Mets. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲבָטוֹ לאלתר</he> (Ar. <he>חבסו</he>, v. <cite ref="H00100"><he>חָבַס</he></cite>) the load pressed him down immediately (before he could find out that it was too heavy for him).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 19b:1">Snh. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲבָטָן בקרקע</he> pressed them into the ground.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:6">Succ. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 45a:3">45ᵃ</cite>) <he>חוֹבְטִין אותן ע״ג קרקע בצידי המזבח</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) they laid them down closely upon one another on the ground by the altar (opp. to <he>זוקפין</he>, ib. IV, 4).
<cite ref="Ketubot 39a:9">Keth. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>צער שחֲבָטָהּ ע״ג וכ׳</he> ‘the pain’ (Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:4">ib. III, 4</cite>) refers to his pressing her down on the hard ground.

senses.gloss: to force, to knock open, esp. to knock upon olives to make them burst, before putting them under the press, or upon ears to thresh the grain out.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36">Ex. R. s. 36</cite>, beg. <he>מורידין … ונחבט ומשחוֹבְטִין וכ׳</he> they take the olive down and it is knocked upon, and after knocking it, they put it into the vat (corresp. to <he>כתש</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:4">Men. VIII, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:4">Ib.</cite> <he>באין או״ה … וחובטין … ממקום וכ׳</he> the gentiles come and knock them (the Israelites) from place to place.
Men. X, 4; a. e.—Part. pass. חָבוּט mashed.
<cite ref="Shabbat 80b">Sabb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>בח׳</he> when the lime is mashed (and mixed with water); Y. ib. VIII, 11ᵇ bot. <he>בחביט</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: to lay down for receiving lashes, in gen. to punish, bind over.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:8">Gitt. IX, 8</cite> <he>ובנכרים חובטין אותו וכ׳</he> but when the gentile authorities bind him over and say, Do as the Israelites tell thee, (the letter of divorce so enforced) is valid (differ. vers. in Y. ed.); <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 12:13">Tosef. Yeb. XII, 13</cite>.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:7">Tosef. Sot. XV, 7</cite> <he>מסרוהו לבעל זמורה וחֲבָטוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. Var. (Y. ib. IX, 24ᵇ top <he>וחבשו</he>) they gave him in charge of the rod-bearer (v. <cite ref="G00511"><he>זְמוֹרָה</he></cite>), and he tried to force him (into submission).
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:2">Midd. I, 2</cite> <he>חוֹבְטוֹ במקלו</he> he punishes him with his cane.

senses.gloss: to be knocked upon; to strike against.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36">Ex. R. s. 36</cite>, v. supra.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 36b:2">Keth. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני שנֶחְבֶּטֶת וכ׳</he> because the blind girl may have struck against something (and fallen, so as to have lost her virginity by the shock).
<cite ref="Chullin 51b">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>עוף שנ׳ על וכ׳</he> a bird that fell with force upon water.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to press down, throw down. Keth. l. c. חִיבְּטָהּ ע״ג שיראין if he forced her down on (soft) silk garments.
to prostrate one’s self (in prayer, in deep commotion).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>היה מִתְחַבֵּט לפני רגליו וכ׳</he> he threw himself to the feet of every one &c. (with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 42:21">Gen. XLII, 21</cite>).

Gen. 123</cite> <he>דבר שנתח׳ וכ׳</he> a thing for which that patriarch (Jacob) begged in prostration; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>שנֶחְבַּט</he>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. <he>עכשיו הוא מתחנן ומתח׳</he> now he supplicates and prostrates himself; a. fr.
